messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

The text is the title of a song by the Beatles. Does John Lennon sing a lead vocal on it?

Text: Got to Get You into My Life

Allowed answers:
- yes
- no

message.content: **No.** "Got to Get You into My Life" (from *Revolver*, 1966) is sung by Paul McCartney, who wrote it as an ode to marijuana. John Lennon does not sing lead vocal on it.
